text:
sasha: hitting intermittent OOMs on canary-optim3 when running bench-llm smallalloc load. grabbing heapshot artifacts in s3://redwood-canary/2033344444/heapshot.gz. can someone run a quick repro and attach perf maps? /cc @jamal @leo
jamal: on it. can you paste the canary args? curious if kv-cache enabled.
sasha: cmd: ./bench --model=mistral-8k --batch=1 --seq=1024 --kv-cache --quant=q4_0. logs: attached snippet
```
OOM at alloc.cc:452: arena->alloc failed
RSS 12G -> sudden jump
```
leo: I can try a local repro with same env. which allocator? jemalloc or tcmalloc? prod uses jemalloc but canaries default to tcmalloc sometimes.
sasha: canary image uses jemalloc 5.2.1. we also have a recent change in prefix cache allocation: PR #4921. suspect growth in small-block arena.
mira: if it's small-blocks, run `jeprof` or `je-malloc-stats` and a heap profile. I can spin up a host with heap profiler enabled. schedule? :clock1: 
jamal: I ran quick meminfo on the node — attached. also started `perf record --call-graph dwarf` for 60s. uploading map to /tmp/perf-2033344444.map
ci-bot: buildbot: Canary run 2033344444 started (image rev: main@c8f3). Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/canary/2033344444
sasha: thanks. mira — can you try reproducing with `--prefix-cache=off`? if that removes spike, we can narrow down.
mira: will try now. quick note: to reproduce OOM quickly, set `--seq=2048` and `--concurrent=4`.
leo: I saw similar pattern last month. adding diagnostic flag `MALLOC_CONF:lg_dirty_mult:2,stats_print:true` helped surface arena growth.
jamal: I can add jemalloc stats to canary job. PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4987
sasha: if anyone gets a heapshot, please run `heapdump2json` and drop in the thread.
mira: repro done locally with seq=2048. with prefix-cache=off peak RSS ~5.1G; with on it jumps to 13.8G and OOM. attaching minimal heap snapshot name heap-2033344444.json
mira: heap snapshot shows many small objects in size class 128-512 bytes from `kv_cache::insert()` line 213 in prefix_cache.cc. looks like vector growth without reserve. patch idea: reserve initial capacity in PrefixShard::buckets.
leo: nice find. can you open a small PR with the reserve and a unit test that simulates lots of small inserts? I'll review.
mira: opened PR 4990 with fix + benchmark. https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4990 :eyes:
jamal: running canary with PR-4990 build now. will post results in 30m.
ci-bot: buildbot: PR-4990 CI passed, perf board updated.
sasha: thanks team. if canary is green, we can promote. also flagging for postmortem template later. :white_check_mark:
jamal: canary results: memory stable, peak 5.3G. no OOM in 1hr run.
sasha: closing loop — will merge PR 4990 after a final review. exporting heap artifacts to /artifacts/canary/2033344444 for compliance.
